name: F575-3 (Hubble)
blurb: F575-3, a low surface brightness dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: f5753-hubble
story: A faint, diffuse dwarf galaxy whose individual stars Hubble set out to map and count, to learn how much mass hides behind its light, a key to the behavior of dark matter. Its stars turned out to be extremely poor in heavy elements.

claims.text: F575-3 is a low surface brightness (LSB) dwarf galaxy
The program aimed to measure mass-to-light ratio, critical to understanding dark matter
The program would map and count its AGB stars
F575-3's stars indicate an extremely low mean metallicity
